  • Literal "Hearing device" → awkward 听力装置 instead of commerce-idiomatic 听力设备 or 助听器

  • Conflating 助听器 with 助听设备 or 听力辅助设备 when your app only supports one category of hardware
  • Inconsistent vocabulary between listing description, promotional text, and screenshot captions when all three mention hearing devices

Machine translation is fine for internal drafts. Finished hearing-device strings need idiomatic zh-Hans that states what hearing hardware you support — while keeping accurate scope. AppLocale rewrites by hand; we do not deliver raw Google Translate or LLM output as finished copy.
